brief:
A 22-year-old man was killed Friday after being stabbed with a sharp object during a fight in the Yarmouk area of Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The stabbing occurred as the two sides clashed in the densely populated neighborhood.

Police opened an investigation into the fatal incident following the death. Authorities did not immediately release details on the circumstances that sparked the initial quarrel or the identity of those involved.
